label: SenseNova U1.5 8-step
description: SenseNova's own distillation LoRA: 8 Euler steps at CFG 1 (flow shift 3) instead of 50 steps at CFG 4. Set the steps and CFG to match when you apply it, a run configuration with it as a default LoRA keeps them together.

label: HunyuanVideo 1.5 480p text-to-video 4-step (lightx2v)
description: lightx2v's 4-step distillation of the 480p text-to-video checkpoint, as repackaged by Comfy-Org: 4 steps at CFG 1 with flow shift 9 (lightx2v's settings), 848×480. Set those when you apply it; a run configuration with it as a default LoRA keeps them together. Made for the 480p text-to-video weights, not the 720p ones.

label: Boogu Image Turbo 4-step (rank 128)
description: The Turbo distillation as a LoRA over the Base checkpoint: 4 steps at CFG 1 instead of 25 to 50 at CFG 4. Set the steps and CFG to match when you apply it — a run configuration with it as a default LoRA keeps them together. Boogu publishes Turbo as a whole checkpoint, not as a LoRA; this is Comfy-Org's rank-128 extraction of it, from the repository drift seeds the checkpoints from, and it spares a second 20 GB download when the Base model is already on disk. The hotfix build is the one offered; the repository also holds the first extraction.
